source_method: agent-reach GitHub development workflow; anonymous read-only HTTPS shallow clones

repositories.name: withastro/astro
repositories.use: Astro portfolio starter structure, static page composition, config and asset organization.
limitations: The repository is a framework monorepo and the example is a starter, not a finished industrial-design portfolio.
Example images and other media should be treated as reference-only until their individual rights are verified; the repository MIT license does not automatically license third-party assets.

repositories.name: Thinkmill/keystatic
repositories.license: MIT (root LICENSE; Thinkmill Labs Pty Ltd)
repositories.use: Reference for content modeling and a Git-backed CMS workflow if the portfolio later needs structured case-study editing.
limitations: Keystatic is an experimental CMS/monorepo, not a visual portfolio template.
Use the public APIs and documented integration points; do not copy unrelated development fixtures or assume the whole monorepo is required.

repositories.name: van-thurm/portfolio-kit
repositories.scope: Astro portfolio template, layouts, data files and case-study conventions
repositories.use: Reference for restrained editorial portfolio IA, case-study layouts, centralized identity data and static deployment.
limitations: The template includes project-specific fonts, screenshots, GIFs and other media; MIT code licensing does not grant rights to reuse those assets.
Bundled Cursor skills and content conventions are optional and should not be copied into this project without a separate need and review.
